title: After closing.
intro: A shutter, a chair, a little water. Three ways into an ordinary street.

observations.name: Shutter
observations.title: A shutter wearing the weather.
observations.copy: Blue paint holds in the grooves. Rust gathers at the edges. The shop is closed, but its front keeps a record of every season it has stood through.
observations.prompt: Look at what time leaves behind.

observations.name: Chair
observations.title: A chair keeping the doorway.
observations.copy: Nobody is sitting here. Still, the chair turns a threshold into a place to stay. A small invitation, left out after the shop has closed.
observations.prompt: Notice the things that make room for someone.

observations.name: Waterline
observations.title: A garden with no address.
observations.copy: A little water follows the edge of the street. A plant has found the crack beside it. No pot, no sign, no permission: just enough room to grow.
observations.prompt: Follow the water. See what follows it.
